Three diagram zones below: small green-bordered 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' schematic on the far left, large tan rounded 'Multi-Head Attention' zoom container in the center (with a red WE ARE HERE pin on its top-left corner), and the full green-bordered Encoder–Decoder architecture panel on the right. Red dotted zoom-lines connect left schematic → center zoom → right panel's encoder attention block. A thin dark-red frame borders the whole slide.

layout.hierarchy: Title is the largest text (red, bold, ~36 pt). The right architecture panel is the largest object and anchors the right half; the tan center zoom dominates the middle; the left schematic is smallest/least prominent. Red accents (title, pin, dotted lines, red block borders, red arrows) plus yellow highlights steer the eye; all diagram text is very small (~8–10 pt).

visual_elements.description: Scaled Dot-Product Attention schematic (left). Thin dark-green rectangular border with small green corner handles [?]. Bottom-to-top: three circles 'Q' (red), 'K' (blue), 'V' (blue); Q and K feed a lavender 'MatMul' box; arrow up to pale-yellow 'Scale'; up to pink 'Mask (opt.)'; up to light-green 'SoftMax'; up to a second lavender 'MatMul'; V sends a long arrow up the right side into this top MatMul; output arrow exits upward. Thin black arrows; small black sans-serif labels.
visual_elements.position: left, ~5–20% width, ~48–90% height; red italic label above

visual_elements.description: Multi-Head Attention zoom (center). Tan rounded rectangle (#EAC08F) with darker tan border and dark-green L-shaped corner brackets inside its four corners. Red bold-italic label 'Multi-Head Attention' at top inside. Bottom-to-top: circles 'V' (purple), 'K' (purple), 'q' (red, slightly larger); each feeds a pale-yellow 'Linear' box (three in a row; the rightmost above q appears salmon-highlighted [?]); arrows converge into a large salmon 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' box with red border, drawn as a stack of ~4 offset copies (parallel heads) with a thin leader line to annotation '× h' at its right; arrow up to pale-yellow 'Concat'; arrow up to pale-yellow 'Linear'; output arrow exits top. Thin black arrows throughout.

Full Encoder–Decoder Transformer architecture (right). Green-outlined panel; interior split ~55% tan (Encoder) / ~45% pale green (Decoder); red italic labels 'Encoder' (top-left) and 'Decoder' (top-right). Encoder column bottom→top: text 'Inputs' with thick red up-arrow; tan-brown box 'Input Embedding'; black ⊕ (circle-plus) with two-line gray label 'Positional Encoding' at its left; arrow up through circles V (green), K (blue), Q (red) into gray 'Multi-Head Attention' box with red highlight border; small gray 'Add & Norm'; green-outlined rounded rectangle grouping 'Add & Norm' (top) and gray 'Feed Forward'; output arrow up; gray 'N×' at mid-height left of stack. Decoder column bottom→top: yellow-highlighted text 'Outputs (shifted right)'; maroon box 'Output Embedding'; ⊕ with 'Positional Encoding' label at its right; arrow up through V/K/Q circles into purple 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' box with red border; small gray 'Add & Norm'; V/K/Q circles feeding gray 'Multi-Head Attention' box with red border (also receiving K,V from the encoder top [?]); 'Add & Norm'; green-outlined rounded rectangle with 'Add & Norm' and 'Feed Forward'; light-green 'Linear'; light-green 'Softmax'; yellow-highlighted 'Output Probabilities' with thick red up-arrow; gray 'N×' at mid-height right of stack. A dark-red dashed curved arrow sweeps from beside 'Outputs (shifted right)' up along the decoder's right edge to 'Output Probabilities' (autoregressive loop). Thin black vertical arrows connect all stacked components.

Red dotted 'zoom' connector lines: two lines from the right edge of the left schematic converge on the 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' block inside the center zoom; two more dotted lines run from the zoom's right edge to the red-bordered encoder 'Multi-Head Attention' block in the right panel.

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title: bold, ~36–40 pt, red, title case with spaced en dash. Diagram panel labels ('Scaled Dot-Product Attention', 'Multi-Head Attention', 'Encoder', 'Decoder'): bold italic red, ~14–18 pt. 'WE ARE HERE': white bold ALL-CAPS on the pin. All block labels inside diagrams: ~8–10 pt regular, black/dark gray. 'N×' and 'Positional Encoding' in small gray text. Note inconsistent capitalization is original: 'SoftMax' (left schematic) vs 'Softmax' (right panel), lowercase 'q' in center zoom. No serif fonts, no numbered bullets, no body paragraphs.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built (final state). The WE ARE HERE pin, red dotted zoom lines, yellow highlights and red block borders read as permanent emphasis overlays, not a mid-build; no partially revealed bullets.
